how_to_apply: Fill in the "Format for Application" printed with the notice. Under "Position applied for", write Marketing Expert. The format opens with the line "Advertisement No.: Notice dated".

Fill in each item of the format: name, father's/husband's name, address for communication, mobile number and e-mail ID, date of birth and age as on the last date of application, category (SC/ST/OBC/GEN) and nationality.

List your educational qualifications in chronological order, starting from SSC (10th), and then any professional/technical qualifications. For each, give the examination passed, the year of passing, the university, the subjects studied and the division/% of marks obtained.

List your work experience in chronological order, starting with your first job. For each job, give the employer's name and address, the period of service (from/to), the designation and scale of pay, the total length of service, and the nature of work and level of responsibilities.

State whether you are presently employed and, if so, whether in Government, a PSU, an Autonomous Institution or the Private Sector. Also state whether your present job is permanent, temporary or ad-hoc. Then add a brief write-up on how your past experience relates to the post, and any other relevant information.
Sign the Declaration & Certificate, with the place and date.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below.

Submit the application by e-mail to [email protected], by hand, or by post to A-Block, NI MSME Campus, Street No. 4, Rahmat Nagar, Yousufguda, Hyderabad, Telangana - 500045, so that it reaches the office on or before 18 November 2026.
Application in the prescribed format, signed
Attested copy of proof of age

Original certificates/documents, to be produced at the interview/interaction or document verification, if called for
important_instructions: Applications received after the prescribed last date, and incomplete applications, are liable to be rejected. The Selection Committee will decide the number of vacancies/posts. KVIC reserves the right to modify or cancel the recruitment process, increase or decrease the number of positions, or reject any or all applications without assigning any reason. The declaration in the form states that if any particulars are found incorrect or suppressed, the candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage, during or after selection. If this is found after appointment, the services are liable to be terminated without any notice. content_sections.heading: About KVIC Marketing Expert
content_sections.text: The Khadi and Village Industries Commission works under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt. of India, and uses the brand name Khadi India. This notice comes from the Commission's State Office, Telangana, at Block - A, NI-MSME Campus, Yousufguda, Hyderabad - 500045. The Director signed it at Hyderabad on 25 October 2026. The Marketing Expert will be posted at this State Office, and the remuneration follows the "timely PMEGP / KVIC guidelines".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice accepts either of these two combinations: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or any other discipline with 5 years' experience in the relevant field, preferably in Small-Scale and Village Industries, Handicrafts, etc. OR MBA (Marketing) with 2 years' experience in the relevant field, preferably in Small-Scale and Village Industries, Handicrafts, etc. Experience in Small-Scale and Village Industries, Handicrafts and similar areas is "preferably" required: it is a preference, not a condition. Under "Experience", the notice lists: Previous experience in sales, marketing, advertising and brand management. Excellent analytical and data analysis skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Extensive knowledge of current and relevant markets in rural India for Village or Cottage Industries. Should be well-versed in Telugu. The maximum age is 40 years. The application format asks for the candidate's age as on the last date of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates who state SC/ST/OBC in the form must attach documentary proof. For the exact eligibility of the post, see the official notification. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: a lump-sum consolidated amount of Rs. 50,000/- per month (as per timely PMEGP / KVIC guidelines). Allowances: no other allowance or benefit is admissible except as specifically provided by KVIC. Nature of engagement: purely contractual and temporary. The engagement does not confer any right to regular appointment in KVIC. Period of engagement: up to 31 March 2027. It may be extended for a further period, subject to KVIC's requirement and the selected candidate's satisfactory performance. Travel: the selected candidate(s) may be required to travel as part of official duties, as applicable to the post, including field visits from the Hyderabad State Office.

content_sections.heading: KVIC Marketing Expert Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key responsibilities of the Marketing Expert: Develop, implement and track marketing programmes such as email, social media or digital campaigns, and events. Collaborate with other internal teams to develop and monitor strategic marketing initiatives. Analyse and report on the performance and efficiency of campaigns. Conduct market research and analyse trends to identify new marketing opportunities. Develop and create marketing materials, such as sales and product collateral, and ensure that guidelines are met. Write, proofread and edit creative and technical content across different mediums. Work with external agencies and vendors to execute marketing programmes. Demonstrate excellent time management skills and the ability to balance multiple projects simultaneously. Ability to travel as necessary.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVIC Marketing Expert
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format, signed Attested copy of proof of age Attested copies of educational qualifications Attested copies of professional/technical qualifications, if any Attested copies of experience certificates Documentary proof of category, if SC/ST/OBC Original certificates/documents, to be produced at the interview/interaction or document verification, if called for

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through shortlisting and/or interview, or both, as the Selection Committee decides. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not give any right to selection. Candidates called for an interview/interaction or document verification should produce their original certificates/documents. The notice does not give an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KVIC Marketing Expert Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The count is 1 (1 for the post - the notice does not print a number). The notice says the Selection Committee will decide the number of vacancies/posts, and KVIC may increase or decrease the number of positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KVIC Marketing Expert post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the KVIC State Office, Telangana, on or before 18 November 2026. Late or incomplete applications are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for KVIC Marketing Expert?
faq.answer: You need either a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or any other discipline with 5 years' experience in the relevant field, or an MBA (Marketing) with 2 years' experience. Experience in Small-Scale and Village Industries, Handicrafts, etc. is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KVIC Marketing Expert post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years. The application format asks for your age as on the last date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a KVIC Marketing Expert?
faq.answer: The post pays a lump-sum consolidated amount of Rs. 50,000/- per month, as per timely PMEGP / KVIC guidelines.

faq.answer: No, unless KVIC specifically provides one. The notice says no other allowance or benefit is admissible except as specifically provided by KVIC.

faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application format and attach self-attested copies of your documents. faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for KVIC Marketing Expert?
